title: Empirical ObjectPack identity-semantics binding before one-shot RS0 execution

blocking_findings.detail: The governing C2P v0.2 ObjectPack constitution requires exact matching predicates, numeric residual definitions, tolerances and relation/topology checks to be frozen ObjectPack content. PS0 candidates B/C name owner_declared_geometry_compatible and C additionally names c2e_lineage_compatible_if_declared, but the candidate records bind no exact compatibility registry/version/hash, tolerance/residual definition or executable owner rule.

The current core candidate/adjudication runtime is intentionally synthetic-only. candidate.py rejects non-synthetic ObjectPacks and adjudication.py implements only the synthetic identity predicates same_hard_scope, same_fixture_structure_key, same_coordinate_class and monotonic_fixture_step. rs0_execution.py validates/streams source rows but does not evaluate A/B/C identity semantics.
GRUN authorises one preregistered comparative A/B/C run on a common source population. Executing A while omitting or inventing B/C semantics would change the approved comparison and is forbidden.

acceptance_conditions_for_unblock: Every identity-defining empirical predicate used by A/B/C is bound to an exact versioned/hash-addressed executable contract or registry.
Geometry compatibility semantics for B/C are exact, causal, owner/source-bound and contain no future/outcome/family/C3/probability inputs.
C2E lineage/boundary compatibility semantics for C are exact and apply only when the candidate role explicitly declares the dependency.
Any numeric residual/tolerance used by identity adjudication is frozen before real-source execution.
The empirical Candidate->Tracklet->ObjectAssertion runtime implements the exact frozen predicates and passes the existing PS0 adversarial corpus plus new execution-binding fixtures.
Reference/optimized equivalence, restart/replay equivalence, source-row causality and capacity fail-closed tests pass.
If semantic completion changes candidate logical identity or GRUN-bound candidate content, create successor candidate generation(s) and obtain a fresh operator GRUN decision before launch.
No ObjectPack is selected or activated and the one-run token remains unconsumed until the exact comparative run launches.

may_define: deterministic empirical A/B/C runtime and assurance
does_not_authorise: real-source launch under changed candidate identity without fresh GRUN currentness/approval

warnings: The previous GRUN approval was technically approvable on source/capacity/run-envelope evidence but did not prove that all named empirical identity predicates had executable frozen semantics. That omission is preserved as an execution-time fail-closed finding rather than repaired by inference.
Synthetic coordinate_class compatibility is not lawful empirical geometry compatibility and must not be reused as a shortcut.
unresolved_issues: Exact empirical geometry-compatibility semantics for PS0 B/C.
Exact C2E lineage/boundary compatibility semantics for PS0 C when episode-relative dependency is declared.
Whether completing those semantics can preserve the current candidate logical identities or requires successor PS0 candidate generations and a renewed GRUN approval.

qa.rationale: Launching now would require inventing identity-defining semantics or changing the approved A/B/C comparison.

rollback: No market run has started. Preserve GRUN authority, source materialisation and all blocker evidence. Forward-supersede only after exact semantic/runtime bindings are lawfully approved and materialised.
exact_work_after_operator_pass: Create a bounded PS0/RS0 semantic-binding packet from latest lawful main.
Freeze exact empirical compatibility predicates/registries and determine whether candidate hashes must advance.
Implement the reference empirical A/B/C runtime against those exact bindings.
Run synthetic/adversarial and repository-wide assurance; preserve no-winner/no-activation boundaries.
If candidate identity changed, regenerate the comparative preregistration/currentness packet and return for fresh GRUN PASS; otherwise prove the existing GRUN binding remains exact.
Only then launch the single A/B/C real-source shadow run and consume the one-run token.
